translations.web: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
translations.bsb: And a voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to Him!”
translations.kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
translations.asv: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my Son, my chosen: hear ye him.
